notes: Read SKILL.md and references/advanced.md, references/mcp.md, references/threads.md, references/tools.md in full. Python guide for the Microsoft Agent Framework (agent-framework-azure-ai) on Azure AI Foundry: AzureAIAgentsProvider, function tools, hosted code interpreter/file search/Bing tools, MCP tools, threads, streaming, structured outputs, OpenAPI tools, retries and logging.

Tells the agent to `pip install agent-framework --pre` or `agent-framework-azure-ai --pre` (SKILL.md:31,34; unpinned pre-release) and samples authenticate with AzureCliCredential/DefaultAzureCredential to create persistent agents, upload files and create vector stores in the user's own Foundry project; threads.md:71-83 writes a conversation-ID JSON file. Medium because of the pre-release package install and live-service credential use; acceptable because the packages are Microsoft's official SDK and all calls target the user's own Azure project with Entra ID auth.

MCP samples set approval_mode="never_require" (references/mcp.md:37,53,64,81,291), which lets the hosted agent call remote MCP tools without approval in the user's generated app; mcp.md:76-99 documents always_require and per-tool approval as alternatives. Bearer placeholders ("your-api-key") appear in header samples; advanced.md:490 enables DEBUG logging which can log request details. Created agents/threads/vector stores persist server-side and are not cleaned up in samples.
